noveltyJustification: Three findings are fully new (style-guide contradiction, tagged-release disposition, goal-state residue) and three refine prior findings (authored .d.ts scope, Smaller Fixes placement, frozen-history split).

graphEvents.label: TypeScript style guide lacks compiler-emitted .d.ts exemption
22 non-archived goal.md files carry stale specs/hooks references

label: The sk-code TypeScript style guide, not only the checklist, still requires a module header from every TypeScript file: overview-strict-and-naming.md line 36 says all TypeScript files MUST begin with a module header block, with no compiler-emitted .d.ts carve-out, while verify_alignment_drift.py line 565 defines DECLARATION_SUFFIXES (.d.ts, .d.mts, .d.cts), line 569 treats a declaration ending in its source-map comment as compiler-written, and line 592 raises the missing-header finding, so a generated declaration passes the guard but violates the guide.

The exemption must name compiler-emitted declarations only: formatting-imports-and-coexistence.md lines 294-299 still describes authored .d.ts files co-located with a JS module and sharing its basename, and those have no source-map trailer, so the guard keeps requiring their header; the fix wording should cover .d.ts, .d.mts and .d.cts generated by the compiler and leave authored declarations on the existing rule, with the checklist row at typescript-checklist.md line 47 carrying the same wording.

v4.0.2.0 is a tagged release (git tag --list v4.0.2* prints v4.0.2.0), so the open-release extension path is closed: extend-open-release.md lines 25-31 and 62-63 extend only an untagged latest entry and fail a run that extends a tagged one, while SKILL.md lines 245-247 allow amending a published entry via build_release_notes.py and gh release edit with the tag in place, and sk-create-changelog changelog v1.4.3.0 line 16 records that the v4.0.2.0 notes were amended four times; the branch is chosen by whether the ten commits are ancestors of the tag.

If v4.0.2.0 is amended, the ten repairs belong in the existing Docs and Tooling section (line 195) under or beside the Smaller Fixes list (lines 209-217), and the omission rule at SKILL.md lines 262-263 forbids file inventories, test counts, process detail, housekeeping items and task or packet IDs outside the spec line, so the .gitignore and leaf-aliases regeneration may not earn bullets while the guard, track-root and doctor changes do.

The live specs/hooks/ residue under specs/ is goal state: excluding research, review, research_archive, run1-archive, scratch and z_archive, 22 non-archived goal.md files still name the old track, including an unchecked acceptance box whose command is validate.sh specs/hooks/023-session-relaunch-loop/034-default-off-opt-in --strict at 034-default-off-opt-in goal.md line 58 and a packet_pointer under specs/hooks at 011-post-fix-remediation goal.md line 10, so a resume on those packets resolves or executes a dead path that 478cdec696 never repointed.

The other specs/ hits are frozen history, not live links: non-archived spec.md, plan.md, tasks.md, acceptance-criteria.md and implementation-summary.md rows still quote specs/hooks/ in run transcripts, and filesystem-naming-convention.md lines 66-74 freeze completed spec-folder history like changelogs and archives, so the fix list is the 22 goal.md files plus the .skilled live set from iteration 1 rather than a repo-wide rewrite.

direction: Extending v4.0.2.0 in place as if it were an untagged open release
reason: The v4.0.2.0 tag exists; extend-open-release.md lines 25-31 and 62-63 fail a run that extends an entry whose tag exists.
